headline: September was the strongest month of the year: $20,200 in sales and $3,413 of net operating income
model_notes: September sales were $20,200, up 28% from August and about double September 2025
Weekday traffic averaged 132 transactions a day, the highest of the year, at a $7.31 average ticket
Net operating income was $3,413, or 16.9% of sales
Labor was 32% of sales. Part of that is timing against August; the two months together ran 41%
Cost of goods was 38% of sales, in line with the year to date
Year to date through September the cafe has earned $6,905 on $145,872 of sales
outlook: The model projects sales of about $17,600 in October, $14,550 in November and $12,400 in December
Full year 2026 is projected at about $7,400 of net operating income on $190,400 of sales
The slower holiday months (November through January) remain the main risk to that figure
next_steps: Catering has been under $300 a month since July, against $1,000 or more in the first four months of the year
The September staffing pattern handled the busiest month of the year; the plan is to hold it through October
next_steps_p3: Slipstream will work on vinyl window coverings to increase visibility while waiting for feedback on outdoor seating options
Slipstream is working on holiday season events and catering marketing material for holiday parties to partially offset winter slowdown
